selection_rule: Use the existing deterministic 18-instance engineering subset; pilot is the first six rows in stable problem-id order. No ORLM output or outcome was used for selection.
common_comparison_scope: NLP4LP records suitable for full natural-language-to-model generation; ORLM-native metrics remain separate from scalar-grounding metrics.
pilot_rationale: Includes both LP and MILP metadata.
The manifest is fixed before ORLM inference and contains no success-based filtering.
exclusion_criteria: Do not label this as PaMOP's exact 67-instance set.
Exclude rows with missing raw text or missing structured gold metadata at execution time, recording the reason explicitly.
Do not silently replace an excluded row with another row.
